list.name: gentle-ai
list.description: Gentle-AI configures the AI coding agents you already use: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode, Codex, Pi, and more. Choose persistent memory, Organic-Driven Development, curated skills, MCP servers, personas, and optional bounded review. Open source, no agent lock-in.

list.name: tuios
list.description: A terminal window manager that knows what your agents are doing. Tiling panes, workspaces, sessions that survive restarts, and one Inbox for every coding agent. Official only at tuios.dev and this repo. tuios has no X/Twitter account.

list.name: awesome-ai-agents
list.description: Awesome list of 300+ agentic AI resources

list.name: SafeLine
list.description: SafeLine is a self-hosted WAF(Web Application Firewall) / reverse proxy to protect your web apps from attacks and exploits.

list.name: caveman
list.description: 🪨 why use many token when few token do trick. Viral skill + proxy for coding agents that cuts 65% of tokens by talking like a caveman.

list.name: nuclei
list.description: Nuclei is a fast, customizable vulnerability scanner powered by the global security community and built on a simple YAML-based DSL, enabling collaboration to tackle trending vulnerabilities on the internet. It helps you find vulnerabilities in your applications, APIs, networks, DNS, and cloud configurations.

list.name: caddy
list.description: Fast and extensible multi-platform HTTP/1-2-3 web server with automatic HTTPS

list.name: Fabric
list.description: Fabric is an open-source framework for augmenting humans using AI. It provides a modular system for solving specific problems using a crowdsourced set of AI prompts that can be used anywhere.

list.name: beads
list.description: Beads - A memory upgrade for your coding agent

list.name: beszel
list.description: Lightweight server monitoring with historical data, docker stats, and alerts.

list.name: alloy
list.description: OpenTelemetry Collector distribution with programmable pipelines

list.name: new-api
list.description: A unified AI model hub for aggregation & distribution. It supports cross-converting various LLMs into OpenAI-compatible, Claude-compatible, or Gemini-compatible formats. A centralized gateway for personal and enterprise model management.

list.name: WeKnora
list.description: Open-source LLM knowledge platform: turn raw documents into a queryable RAG, an autonomous reasoning agent, and a self-maintaining Wiki.
